reasons.plausibility: The proposed lattice-strain mechanism and d-band center shift are consistent with known effects of Ru alloying on noble metal catalysts, although some assumptions about the roles of other alloy components remain slightly uncertain.
reasons.testability: Measuring lattice strain and d-band shifts alongside product distribution under well-defined electrochemical conditions provides a clear and decisive way to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Linking composition-induced strain to selectivity addresses a critical research gap for rational catalyst design and could guide future development of similar high-entropy alloys.
